svg.aria-label: MERGED UPSTREAM · REVIEWED BY THE MAINTAINER. containers/crun #2166. crun is the OCI runtime that Podman and CRI-O run containers with. Its passwd parser tested for a digit with a signed comparison and no lower bound, so a passwd line whose uid field is empty walks the parser past the end of the buffer. Traced back to the 2020 commit that dropped a U suffix to silence a warning, and fixed with an explicit range test that stays warning free without a cast. Reviewed and merged by the project maintainer. github.com/containers/crun/pull/2166 · THE BUG IN FULL BELOW ↓
svg.text: MERGED UPSTREAM · REVIEWED BY THE MAINTAINER
crun is the OCI runtime that Podman and CRI-O run containers with. Its passwd parser tested for a digit with a signed
comparison and no lower bound, so a passwd line whose uid field is empty walks the parser past the end of the buffer.
Traced back to the 2020 commit that dropped a U suffix to silence a warning, and fixed with an explicit range test that
stays warning free without a cast. Reviewed and merged by the project maintainer.
